releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.8.6 (Enterprise ID Card Front & Back Scanner 2.0)
changelog:
🪪 Enterprise ID Card Front & Back Scanner 2.0:
• Automatic 4-Corner Edge Detection & Perspective Warping: Table and desk backgrounds are automatically detected and cropped out; skewed card captures are straightened with sub-pixel precision.
• Magic Color Document Enhancement: Whitens background paper and enhances text and photo contrast cleanly (CamScanner/Adobe Scan quality).
• Auto Landscape Orientation: Cards are automatically aligned into standard ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 landscape format.
• Dual-Input Flexibility: Seamlessly switch between Camera Scan and Gallery Picker for both Front and Back sides independently.
• Clean Official KYC Print Layout: Standard A4 print sheet with subtle hairline borders, clean minimal labels, and optional cutting guide (ZERO ads or giant badges).
